description: MainActivity.java: The main activity of an Android app demonstrating scene transition animations between activities, including setup of a grid of items, handling item clicks, and initiating transition to a detail activity using scene transitions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity that displays a grid of items with images and titles. Handles item clicks to transition to a detailed view with scene transition animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the grid view and its adapter.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on grid items, starts DetailActivity with shared element transition animations.
